title: BreweryXRecipes
description: This plugin can show recipes from BreweryX plugin.
body:
This plugin can show recipes from BreweryX plugin.
Also, it's add-on plugin.

### Commands:
    /breweryrecipe <recipe name>
    /brewrecipe <recipe name>
    /brewrp <recipe name>
### Permission:
    breweryxrecipes.use
Min BreweryX version is 3.6.5
